scope: Data-acquisition stop rule only; does not alter research hypotheses or statistical gates.

frozen_stop_rule.final_resume_condition: Only permitted if current run saves cache and diagnostics show the unresolved data footprint is smaller than before.
frozen_stop_rule.if_current_succeeds: Evaluate the full six-category family using the original preregistered gates.
frozen_stop_rule.if_current_fails_but_progresses: Permit one final cached resume with identical research and acquisition specifications.
frozen_stop_rule.if_final_resume_fails: Mark DATA_INCONCLUSIVE and stop this broad GDELT family.
